user.title: Connect your Kindle library
user.description: Uses the same private endpoints as the Kindle Cloud Reader, with your own Amazon sign-in cookies. Read-only. Open a book at read.amazon.co.uk, then copy the cookie request header from that page's request in your browser's dev tools (see the README). The device token is only needed for older Cloud Reader versions; leave it empty.

data.device_token: Device token (optional; the whole getDeviceToken URL is fine)

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect your Kindle library
reauth_confirm.description: Amazon signed this session out. Paste a fresh Cookie header from the Kindle Cloud Reader. The device token can usually stay the same.

error.missing_cookies: Those cookies have no Amazon sign-in token (at-...) or session-id. Copy the whole Cookie header from a request to read.amazon.*.
error.invalid_auth: Amazon did not accept the cookies. Sign in to the Kindle Cloud Reader again and copy fresh ones.
error.invalid_device_token: Amazon wouldn't share reading progress. Add (or refresh) the device token from the getDeviceToken request.
error.blocked: Amazon returned a bot check instead of data. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This Amazon account is already set up.

data.finished_threshold: Count a book as finished at
data.books_to_check: Recent books to check each time

data_description.reading_speed: Used only for the estimated reading time. About 1,500 is an average adult pace; raise it if the estimate runs high.
